parameters.name: HostShareKeyId
parameters.description:
The shared key ID.

>  You must specify this parameter. You can call the [ListHostShareKeys](~~462973~~) operation to query the shared key ID.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The bastion host ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.

>  For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-share-key-id 11206 --region cn-hangzhou
